Welcome to REACH Rehab + Chiropractic Performance Center's YouTube Channel!

We upload weekly content to help our current patients with homework references, as well as pain relief and performance strategies for anyone searching for answers on the interwebs. Some of the main searchable topics we cover are mobility exercises, rehabilitation exercises, core exercises, core workout, functional strength training, breathing exercises, chiropractic adjustment, exercise for back pain, stretches for flexibility, and plenty more!

We know you'll love our content, so make sure to subscribe and hit the bell for notifications. Also, learn more about what we offer at your physical location in Plymouth, MI (right outside of Detroit and Ann Arbor) by visiting https://reachchiro.com.
